title: 3M™ DUST RESPIRATOR MASKS – 8210/N95 Mask / 160/CS
description: 8210 N95 Mask Maintenance free, designed for comfortable wear with reliable protection. Lightweight construc­ tion promotes greater worker acceptance and increased wear time. Applications include grinding sanding, sweeping, bagging and other dusty op­ erations. Advanced Electet® Media welded strap attachment, soft nose foam and adjustable nose clip for custom fit and secure seal.
